info.name: NewApp - Guest Notifications (v2)
info.description:
Postman collection for all newly created and updated endpoints added in the Guest FCM notification feature.

New endpoints:
- POST /api/guest/fcm-token (public – no auth required)

Updated endpoints:
- POST /api/googleLogin (now accepts fcm_token + device_id)
- POST /api/logout (now clears fcm_token on logout)
- POST /api/fcm-token (now also clears token from guest_devices)
- POST /api/send-notification (now includes target filter: all | users | guests)

Collection variables:
  base_url       → http://127.0.0.1:8000
  bearer_token   → set after a successful googleLogin response

item.name: 1. Guest (No Auth Required)
item.description: Endpoints that do NOT require an Authorization header. Call these before the user has logged in.

request.description:
Registers or refreshes an FCM token for a non-logged-in (guest) reader.

- `device_id`: A stable UUID generated once on the client and stored in local device storage. Used to upsert the record idempotently on every app open.
- `fcm_token`: The Firebase Cloud Messaging device registration token.
- `state_id`, `district_id`, `mandal_id`: Optional geo fields used to filter news push notifications by location.

NO Authorization header required.

Call this again after logout if the user wants to keep receiving public news notifications.

response.name: 422 – Validation Failed

item.name: 2. Authentication (Updated Fields)
item.description: Login and logout endpoints that were updated to handle FCM token migration between guest and authenticated state.

exec: console.log('Bearer token saved to collection variable.');

request.description:
Primary reader login via Google OAuth.

**New fields added:**
- `device_id` (nullable): The client-generated stable device UUID. Used to clear the FCM token from `guest_devices` so the device stops receiving guest push notifications after login.
- `fcm_token` (nullable): If provided, the FCM token is saved directly to the user record. **No separate POST /api/fcm-token call is needed.**

The test script auto-saves the returned `access_token` to the `bearer_token` collection variable.

Logs out the authenticated user.

**Updated behaviour:**
1. Clears `fcm_token` on the user's record → device stops receiving authenticated-user push notifications immediately.
2. Revokes the Passport access token.

After calling this, the mobile client should call `POST /api/guest/fcm-token` if the user wants to keep receiving public news push notifications while logged out.

item.name: 3. FCM – Push Notifications (Updated)
item.description: FCM endpoints updated to handle both User and GuestDevice tokens.

request.description:
Saves / refreshes the FCM token for the currently authenticated user.

**Updated behaviour:** Also clears the same FCM token from `guest_devices` if it exists, preventing the device from receiving duplicate notifications (once as a guest, once as a user).

Note: If you pass `fcm_token` directly in `POST /api/googleLogin`, you do NOT need to call this endpoint separately.

Admin endpoint to broadcast a push notification.

**Requires:** `manage-users` permission.

**New `target` field (optional, default: `all`):**
- `all` → sends to ALL registered FCM tokens (authenticated users + guest devices)
- `users` → sends only to logged-in users with FCM tokens
- `guests` → sends only to guest (non-authenticated) devices

**`user_ids` (optional):** When provided, restricts to specific user IDs. Cannot be combined with `target: guests`.
Sends a push notification only to logged-in users (not guest devices). Use `target: users`.

Sends a push notification only to guest devices (non-authenticated readers). Use `target: guests`.

Useful for promotional messages encouraging guests to register.
Sends a push notification to specific user IDs. The `target` field is ignored when `user_ids` is provided.
